address: 4-6 Berkeley Square, Mayfair, London, W1J 6BR, United Kingdom
bio: Everyone will have an opinion about the name but what’s indisputable is that this is a very good looking restaurant, with works by Frank Gehry and Damien Hirst, and a stunning ceiling by Michael Roberts. The fish comes with various Asian influences but don’t ignore the meat dishes like the beef rib skewers....
